question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seen to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All jugs are cans.

All cans are engines.

Some jugs are stoves.

**Con****clusions:**

I. Some engines are stoves.

II. Some cans are jugs.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
